digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler pause/resume surface and gate format migration
propositions: Pause operation blocks before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns rc 0 with exact anchored JSON BRIDGE_PAUSED marker; workflow skips commit-and-push only on complete marker receipt

Pause blob maintains dual-format compatibility: gated_mode reconcile-check plus paused/reason/who/paused_at fields; same-reason re-pause is idempotent and preserves metadata; blank reason, missing identity, missing remote, different reason, and CAS conflict refuse without overwrite
Resume deletes only observed ref OID via CAS and recovers corrupt blob without decoding; corrupt state emits clean rc 1 recovery line without traceback
Pre-gate reconcile-check early return and legacy rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary remain functional; legacy gate rc 4 behavior unchanged
Pause provenance uses repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp; no fallback on missing identity
All public contract surfaces expose pause/resume functionality; no automatic expiry, until flag, gate rename, or vocabulary removal shipped
